headline: 🏆 SUNDAY, AND THE WHOLE BOARD FITS IN TWELVE MINUTES — three emails are already written, addressed and waiting, and the oldest of them is a four-word receipt Molly G. asked for on Tuesday afternoon about the offer on 225 Willow Point. 🔴 THAT THREAD STILL HOLDS EXACTLY ONE MESSAGE, HERS, AT 112 HOURS. ⭐ The send does not require you to open the offer PDF — it names no price — so the one thing blocking it is a click, not a decision. · DO: send Molly G. the receipt — it is already drafted · DECIDE: 2127 Hwy 93 — open the price talk Monday, or hold? · WATCH: 195 Lake View still has no funding receipt, day 2 (verified 8/30 6:5xa).

notes: ✅ THE FLEET RAN CLEAN THROUGH THE NIGHT AND INTO THIS MORNING — four routines fired on time between 4:58 and 6:10, the call lane has already swept three times since 6:10, and the morning letter went out at 6:5x with no dark window anywhere. ⭐ Nothing on this board is stale because a routine failed to fire.

🔴 THE SELLER-IMPORT PEN IS STILL THE ONE GENUINE BLOCK — yesterday's 4:34 PM deep sweep logged it BLOCKED for the fifth consecutive run because the create-lead tool is absent. ⚠️ WHAT IT COSTS: roughly twenty qualified seller-side candidates a day are banked with full receipts instead of landed, and each one also loses its market report and its follow-up sequence. ⭐ THE RIGHT THING KEEPS HAPPENING ANYWAY: no run has invented a workaround and no candidate has been dropped. This one needs your hands — it is an authorisation question, not a code question.

📞 THE TEXT RELAY IS DARK ON DAY FOUR, ROUGHLY EIGHTY-THREE HOURS, AND THE INSTRUMENT IS PROVEN. The lane keeps testing its own eyes: the same query returns hundreds of threads at five days and nothing at eight hours, and voicemail on the same label still delivers. ⚠️ So this is an outage on the forwarding app itself, not a quiet weekend. 🎯 WHAT IT COSTS: anything a client answers by text is invisible here — two live conversations read UNKNOWN rather than unanswered, and that distinction is the honest one.

callBlock.who: Molly G. — the buyer's agent still waiting on four words, day five
callBlock.why: 🔴 SHE ASKED IN WRITING ON TUESDAY AFTERNOON TO BE TOLD THE PACKET ARRIVED, and the thread still holds exactly one message — hers — 112 hours later. ⭐ THE REPLY IS ALREADY WRITTEN, ADDRESSED AND SITTING IN YOUR DRAFTS, and it names no price, so it does not wait on you opening the document. 🎯 This is the single cheapest thing on the board and the oldest debt on it.

callBlock.who: Sondra & Darrell S. — the offer on their house is now day eight and still unread
callBlock.why: 📥 A BUYER-SIGNED OFFER HAS BEEN IN HAND SINCE TUESDAY AND NOBODY ON YOUR SIDE HAS OPENED IT. 🔍 THE NUMBER LIVES INSIDE A PDF NO ROUTINE CAN READ, and the figure people keep repeating is the pre-approval ceiling, not the offer. 🎯 SIXTY SECONDS OF READING UNBLOCKS THREE THINGS AT ONCE: the price, the response deadline, and the ruling you have been carrying on the second agent. ⭐ Five tours across four brokerages and not one agent has ever argued the price.

callBlock.who: Mitsa T. — she answered you in eight minutes and has waited 63 hours
callBlock.why: ✍️ YOU PROMISED HER A DETAILED REPORT ON HER OWN HOME IN WRITING THURSDAY AFTERNOON. She came back with the full renovation list inside eight minutes — and volunteered something you did not ask for: they plan to relocate in 2027 and are unsure what they will be able to afford. 🎯 THAT IS A FUTURE LISTING AND AN OUT-OF-AREA REFERRAL, UNPROMPTED. ⭐ The report is already written. Send it, do not rewrite it — and check the From line first, because she knows you at the other address.

callBlock.who: Connie G. — day four, and this one is not business
callBlock.why: 🖤 SHE TOLD YOU HER HUSBAND DIED OF COVID and that she was in the hospital with it herself and never got to say goodbye. ⭐ THE DRAFT WAITING FOR HER IS A PURE CONDOLENCE — no ask, no real-estate line, and it should stay that way. 🎯 Her answer on moving was already complete and clear: not any time soon, she will call if she decides to. Take that at face value and leave it alone.

callBlock.who: Neely F. — the $1.15M feedback is now day three and she still has not heard it
callBlock.why: 🗣️ THE SECOND TOUR THIS HOUSE HAS EVER HAD PRODUCED ITS FIRST REAL INFORMATION on Friday: the buyers liked a lot about it, called it 'very dated for the asking price' naming paint, kitchen and baths, said it felt hot as if the air conditioning was struggling, and want to sell their own house first. ⭐ EVERY PRICING FIELD ON THE FORM WAS LEFT BLANK. Nobody said too expensive and nobody named a number — so this is condition against price, which is the cheaper problem. ↩️ CORRECTION CARRIED FROM YESTERDAY: Labor Day is 9/7, not this weekend — the urgency is real but it is not a holiday deadline. ⚠️ Rule the A/B before you dial.

callBlock.who: Amy G. — the only unqualified yes on the board, now day fifteen
callBlock.why: 🔥 SHE FILED IT HERSELF: interested YES, her buyers just started looking, they really like it, and the house sits at the TOP of their list. She phoned from inside it mid-showing, which makes a call back returned rather than cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED-RIGHT BLANK — the objection is unasked, not absent, and only a person can ask it. 🔍 CARRY THE STAIRS READ INTO THE CALL: two agents from two brokerages have now named the stairs on this house, so if her buyers are fine with stairs that is a genuine differentiator rather than a worry.

callBlock.who: Scarlett — the CEO move, and it is a text on a Sunday, not a call
callBlock.why: ⏰ SHE POSTED THE CHELSEA FARMS GATE CODE TO THE SHARED BOARD ON 8/21 AND HAS HEARD NOTHING FOR NINE DAYS. ⭐ IT IS NOT A QUESTION YOU OWE HER — IT IS HER ANSWER, WAITING FOR A THANK-YOU. Ten seconds. 🔴 THE TWO THINGS THAT ACTUALLY MOVE: give her the 372 Chelsea Farms list date, because her coming-soon task has been overdue since 8/24 waiting on exactly that and she physically cannot finish while it is blank — and tell her either she screens the three applicants this week or you close them in one sentence each. Doing neither is the only wrong answer, and it is what happened to the last one, who then re-applied.

callBlock.who: Seth B. — a second agent named the stairs, and it changes what this listing needs
callBlock.why: 🔍 TWO INDEPENDENT READS, TWO BROKERAGES, ONE OBJECTION — 'stairs were too steep' on Friday's tour and the identical verdict on 8/13, with every price field left blank both times. ⭐ NOBODY WHO HAS TOURED THIS HOUSE HAS EVER ARGUED THE NUMBER, so a cut buys nothing. 🎯 WHAT IT ACTUALLY CHANGES: name the stairs in the copy and stop inviting single-level buyers, so the tours you get are the ones that can convert. ⚠️ THE CLOCK IS REAL — this listing expires 9/8, so the conversation is worth having this week rather than next. 🔴 And the basement lights reported two weeks ago still have no answer; he is the only one who knows why.

listings.status: 📥 OFFER RECEIVED — day nine, and the number inside it is still unread by anyone on your side
listings.note: 🔴 THE WHOLE FILE IS BLOCKED BEHIND TWO CLICKS. The offering agent asked in writing on Tuesday afternoon to be told the packet arrived; the thread still holds exactly one message, hers, at 112 hours. The reply is drafted, addressed and names no price — so it does not wait on the document. 🔍 THE NUMBER ITSELF IS STILL UNOPENED: the offered price lives inside a PDF no routine can read, and the figure people keep repeating is the pre-approval ceiling, not the offer. Sixty seconds with it ends every guess on this file and unblocks the second-agent ruling that has been unrulable for five days. ⭐ FIVE TOURS ACROSS FOUR BROKERAGES AND NOT ONE AGENT HAS EVER ARGUED THE PRICE — and Friday evening's cancellation was a schedule change from an agent who never got in the house, which is a re-book rather than a loss.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — the read is done, the plan is sent, the call is still not made
listings.note: 🏆 YOU DID THE HARD HALF ON SATURDAY MORNING. Sixty-three pages read line by line, 116 items sorted into seven categories, and a written game plan to your seller before 8:40 in the morning — that is the part most agents skip. 🔴 WHAT IS LEFT IS THE PART YOU PROMISED TWICE IN WRITING: a call. The record now shows two 'tomorrows' and no voice on either. 🎯 THREE PILES BEFORE YOU DIAL — fix, credit, decline. A seller who hears three piles instead of nineteen items says yes on the call. 📞 AND THE BUYER'S AGENT IS STILL WAITING ON A CALLBACK from Friday morning — nine seconds, no reason given, asked for you by name. Do not walk in assuming a topic. ✅ Title came back clean and the taxes are current.

listings.status: ⏳ CLOSING — day two past the appointment and nothing anywhere says the money moved
listings.note: ⏳ THE CLOSING RAN FRIDAY AFTERNOON AND THERE IS STILL NO FUNDING RECEIPT — no deposit alert, no payday notice, through a full weekend of sweeps. ⭐ THE LIKELY INNOCENT REASON IS ON THE RECORD: this seller took a check, and a check settles quietly. Monday either produces the receipt or turns this into a real question. 🎯 THIS BOARD WILL NOT COUNT IT UNTIL SOMETHING SAYS IT FUNDED, which is why the year-to-date figure below is deliberately still short of it. 🔍 THE OTHER ANSWER IS ALSO SITTING IN A DOCUMENT YOU ALREADY HAVE, day six unread: the listing-side rate is printed on the final settlement statement, and on this desk that rate has proven to be per-contract rather than fixed — so every forecast built on an assumed rate is wrong somewhere until it is read. 🎣 Still true: this seller is taking a check, so any wire instruction touching this file is fraudulent on its face.

listings.status: 🗣️ ACTIVE — day 39, and its first-ever substantive feedback is three days old and still untold
listings.note: 🗣️ THE TOUR RAN 1:30 TO 2:30 ON FRIDAY AND THE AGENT FILED A FULL WRITTEN READ AN HOUR LATER — the first substantive feedback this listing has ever produced, on only its second tour ever. Her buyers liked a lot about the house but found it 'very dated for the asking price', naming the paint colours, the kitchen and the baths; they said it felt hot as though the air conditioning was struggling; and they would rather sell their own house first, though they may circle back. ⭐ READ WHAT THE FORM DOES NOT SAY: interested, priced-right and price-recommendation were ALL LEFT BLANK. Nobody argued the number. That makes this condition-versus-price, which is a far cheaper problem than a pricing one. 🔧 THE AIR CONDITIONING IS THE ITEM TO ACT ON — checkable, fixable, and it will reappear on every tour until it is answered. ↩️ CORRECTION: yesterday this desk cited a Labor Day deadline for the price talk. Labor Day is 9/7. The urgency is that the seller lives in the house and still has not heard her own feedback, not the calendar — and 35080's big-house ceiling runs about $950K.

listings.status: 🔍 ACTIVE — two agents named the stairs, neither argued the price, and it expires 9/8
listings.note: 🔍 TWO INDEPENDENT READS FROM TWO BROKERAGES GAVE THE IDENTICAL VERDICT — 'stairs were too steep' on Friday's tour, and the same answer on 8/13. ⭐ BOTH LEFT EVERY PRICE FIELD BLANK: priced-right and price-recommendation, twice, unanswered. Nobody who has toured this house has ever argued the number. 🎯 SO THE CONCLUSION IS NOT A CUT — it is that the stairs are filtering out a buyer type your marketing is still inviting. Name them in the copy and the tours you get become the tours that can convert. 🎉 TRAFFIC IS NOT THE PROBLEM: three brand-new brokerages walked it inside forty-eight hours after two weeks of nothing. 📬 ONE READ IS STILL OUT — Saturday morning's 9:45 tour has filed nothing, now about 22 hours. 🔥 AND THE ONE UNQUALIFIED YES IS NOW DAY FIFTEEN: interested YES, buyers just started looking, house at the TOP of their list, and she phoned from inside it mid-showing. ⚠️ THE LISTING EXPIRES 9/8 — nine days — which makes the seller conversation a this-week item rather than a next-week one.

listings.status: 🔑 ACTIVE — day 160, Friday's tour ran and the read is now two days overdue
listings.note: 🔑 THE SHOWING WENT AHEAD. It slid from 10:15 to 12:30, was re-confirmed, and nothing cancelled it — the eleventh tour this unit has taken. 📬 NO FEEDBACK HAS COME BACK, and at roughly 43 hours that is now worth one nudge rather than more waiting; it is the most valuable outstanding read on the whole board. ⚠️ THE ACCESS QUESTION WAS NEVER VISIBLY ANSWERED: the agent asked whether there is a Supra or a lockbox and no reply is on record anywhere the fleet can see. She evidently got in, but it is worth knowing which. 🔴 THE CLIENT HIMSELF IS THE OTHER OPEN ITEM — you wrote him a week ago under 'the straight conversation I owe you' and heard nothing, because a price talk is a phone conversation. A tour that just happened is a reason to ring that is news rather than chasing.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — 45 showings, no offer, and the September block still holds
listings.note: ⚠️ FRIDAY'S TOUR CANCELLED TWO MINUTES BEFORE THE APPOINTMENT, and the agent's reason is the most useful sentence this listing has produced in weeks: his buyer fell in love with a house they had just seen and told him to cancel before she ever walked yours. She never got inside, so this says nothing about the house. 🔍 WHAT IT DOES HAND YOU IS THE ONE QUESTION THE FEEDBACK FORMS NEVER ANSWER — what did she buy instead, and what did it have that yours didn't. Sixty seconds on the phone. ⭐ FORTY-FIVE SHOWINGS AND STILL NO OFFER IS THE WHOLE STORY OF THIS FILE — traffic was never the problem, and four independent agents have filed the same pricing verdict with the recommendation field left blank every time. 🎉 TRAFFIC IS NOT GONE: two consecutive mornings are reserved for 9/12 and 9/13 by an agent who has never shown it. 🎯 One named buyer has already put a number under the ask in writing and is still uncalled, thirteen days on.

listings.status: ✅ THE NUMBER WENT OUT — and the real argument turns out not to be price
listings.note: ✅ CLOSED OUT: the value report reached them Thursday afternoon at a recommended list well below what he had in mind, and it names the four-thousand-plus square foot comparables he asked about — which is the deciding fact of the whole spread. That was the first mail to a Holleman address in the record. 🎤 AND THE THING THAT ACTUALLY CLOSES THIS GAP CAME OFF A RECORDED CONVERSATION, NOT THE COMPS: they want a garden home — main-level garage, no yard work, in one of three specific neighbourhoods. ⭐ SO DO NOT WIN THE PRICE ARGUMENT, WIN THE MOVE. A seller who knows exactly where they are going stops negotiating against their own number. 🔍 The measurement question still stands underneath it: the county count and the seller's count differ by roughly the finished basement you walked, and whoever brings the tape measure wins the listing.

All three gates are essentially behind it. ⚠️ TWO QUIET ITEMS REMAIN, BOTH PAPERWORK RATHER THAN CONDITION, AND BOTH ARE NOW THIRTEEN DAYS OLD: the inspection requests have sat with your seller since 8/17, and the closing attorney still cannot find your seller's name in title, with a third name showing on the same file. ⭐ NEITHER FIXES ITSELF, and a title-vesting problem discovered in September on a September closing is exactly the kind that moves a date.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof addendum closed out and archived, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 BOTH SELLERS HAVE SIGNED and the file has now held steady through more than a dozen consecutive engine runs with nothing new to catch. Scope agreed, any licensed roofer acceptable, and the buyer's agent said all good before either signature landed — the whole loop opened and closed inside one business day. 🔍 ONLY THE ESCROW HOLDBACK SIZING REMAINS LIVE, and that is a number to agree rather than a condition to fix. ⚠️ The old unsent draft to that agent is moot — do not send it on top of a conversation that already ended well.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — 22.63 acres, price ruled, list date still blank
listings.note: ⏳ THE OLDEST IGNORED ITEM YOU OWN IS NINE DAYS OLD AND IT IS NOT A QUESTION — your coordinator posted the gate code to the shared board on 8/21 and nobody has said a word since. It is her answer, waiting on a thank-you, and it costs ten seconds. 🔴 WHAT IS STILL GENUINELY MISSING IS YOUR LIST DATE, and her coming-soon task has been overdue since 8/24 waiting on it. She physically cannot finish while it is blank. ✅ THE SELLER HAS DONE HIS HALF COMPLETELY — he answered everything six days ago and attached the covenants; only the perc test and the health-department permit remain. ⚠️ And its first-ever outreach wave lost a fifth of itself on delivery: two of ten targeted land names hard-bounced within sixty seconds.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, no tours in the window, and one old post still shows the wrong number
listings.note: 🎉 PUBLISHING IS BACK and this morning's Sunday blitz staged the week's placements clean. 🔴 THE ONE ITEM PUBLISHING CANNOT FIX FOR YOU IS THE STALE POST: an 8/20 placement still shows this house five thousand dollars above its current price, and only you can delete it. A wrong number on a live listing is worse than no post at all. 🔍 THE OBJECTION ON THIS HOUSE IS SQUARE FOOTAGE, NOT THE NUMBER, on both passes it took — so another cut buys nothing. 📭 Zero tours inside the fourteen-day window.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — highest lead yield you own, and the buy-boxes keep getting clearer
listings.note: 🔍 TWO BUYERS HAVE NOW TOLD YOU WHAT THEY ACTUALLY WANT, AND NEITHER IS THIS — one wants un-entitled acreage, and the other killed the land idea outright and handed you a house filter instead: thirty-three to thirty-five hundred square feet, basement, built after 1990, nothing near a railroad. ⭐ THOSE ARE NOT REJECTIONS, THEY ARE ASSIGNMENTS. You now know exactly what to send each of them, and one of the two searches flips entirely from land to acreage homes. ⚠️ THE PERC ANSWER IS STILL THE GATE and it is still sitting on a board instead of in an ear: your teammate found it and no buyer has been told. 🔴 Two names were closed out by the decay rule and neither was ever called — that is the cost of the gate, measured in people. 📞 A builder who asked for the lot layout two weeks ago has taken two emails into silence; the phone is what is left.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — goes live TODAY, Sunday 8/30
listings.note: 🚀 TODAY IS THE DAY. ⏳ WILLOW POINT IS THE WHOLE ARGUMENT FOR MOVING FAST ON THE FIRST HOURS: that listing ran paid ads for three days before anyone toured it, then took five bookings and a buyer-signed offer in eleven days once the market actually found it. 🔍 THE GAP THAT COSTS MONEY IS BETWEEN PHOTOS-READY AND BOOKED, and it is entirely inside your control. 🎉 PUBLISHING IS BACK ONLINE and the queue is open, so unlike Friday the machine can carry this one from hour zero.

pipeline.paceProjection: ⏳ NUMBER TWENTY-FOUR CLOSED ON PAPER FRIDAY AFTERNOON AND THIS BOARD IS STILL COUNTING 23 — deliberately. The appointment hour passed two days ago and nothing anywhere says the money moved: no deposit alert, no payday notice, through a full weekend of sweeps. A scheduled closing is not a closed one. ⭐ THE LIKELY INNOCENT REASON IS ON THE RECORD — this seller took a check, and a check settles quietly. Monday either produces the receipt or turns this into a real question. The moment a funding receipt lands, this line goes to 24. 📈 WHAT IT MOVES WHEN IT DOES: at day 242, 23 closings annualises to about 34.7 — a second straight day under the 35 survive line; twenty-four takes the run rate past 36. ⚠️ NO FRESH PIPELINE & FORECAST EMAIL EXISTS INSIDE THE EIGHT-DAY WINDOW — re-queried this morning and the search came back empty, and the forecast is a Monday rack that is not due on a Sunday. So these figures are carried rather than re-derived, and they are at least printed consistently at 23 across the letter, the money lane and this board. 🎯 THE INSTRUMENT THAT ENDS THE BIGGEST OPEN ARGUMENT IS STILL SITTING UNREAD IN YOUR INBOX at day six — the final settlement statement carries the listing-side rate in print, and that rate is per-contract on this desk, receipted two different ways on two recent files. Until it is read, the month is a range rather than a number. ⏳ BEHIND IT: 198 Rena with escrow open and a clean commitment closing 9/21, 225 Willow Point holding a buyer-signed offer nobody has opened, 3350 Altamont on 9/14, and 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 outside the window. Anything closing inside 2026 must be under contract by roughly Oct 31. 👥 Team pace against 90 is Monday's number — this desk will not estimate it on a Sunday.

money.note: ✅ NO NEW BANK ALERT HAS ARRIVED IN THE LAST TWENTY-FOUR HOURS — the mailbox was re-queried this morning across every alert sender and came back empty. ⚠️ THAT IS QUIET, NOT SETTLED. Friday's returned debit was stamped early Saturday and the merchant behind it has still never been named; a biller can re-present up to two more times, and a re-presentment lands on a business day rather than a weekend — so Monday, not Sunday, is when this is actually answered. 🔍 THE ONE MOVE THAT ENDS IT is still the same five minutes: open the personal register and read the merchant name. 📅 THE FIND OF THE MORNING was a bill nobody was counting — a utility draw dated 09/01 that was never inside the fourteen-day window, landing the same day as an existing recurring draft. Whether it auto-drafts, and from which account, is not on the receipt, so this desk is not guessing it. 📉 THE FOURTEEN-DAY VIEW IS SHORT, and the entire day-over-day worsening is that one discovered bill rather than new spending. ⚠️ THE HONEST LIMIT: the cash figure it is measured against is stamped past this desk's own twenty-four-hour line, so the shortfall is directional, not receipted — the same discipline that was missing on 8/23 when a failure was called off a four-day-old number and was wrong. 📈 The equity position posted its first up day in three, and the market was closed, which is the whole story. 📚 The books are flat with no new misbooking; one standing misstatement still needs reclassifying before the September filing deadline. ⚠️ Balances, amounts and account details are deliberately withheld — this page is public.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔍 133 ROWS OPEN IN THE CALL LANE, 119 OF THEM DUE OR OVERDUE RIGHT NOW, AND 53 OF THOSE ARE p1 — the gap between 133 and 119 is the whole problem, because it means almost nothing on this list is waiting on a future date. It is waiting on you. 🛑 TODAY IS A SUNDAY NO-TOUCH DAY AND THE LANE IS HONOURING IT — two verified inbound buyers who registered on your site late Saturday night are being deliberately HELD for Monday 7 AM rather than emailed on a Sunday. That is a rule working, not a miss. 🎯 THE USEFUL DISTINCTION WAS NEVER AGE, IT IS DIRECTION. Roughly a third of this list is people actively waiting on YOU — a returned call, an answered question, a promise in your own words with a timestamp on it. Those cost relationships. The rest are prospects to chase, and they only cost opportunities. 🔧 A REAL FIX SHIPPED THIS MORNING: the lane's overnight lookback could not span a Sunday hold, which made a late-Saturday buyer invisible to both of its queries by Monday. The window was widened to 72 hours and the fix was proven live on the 6:10 and 7:15 runs. 🔴 THE TWO OLDEST SELLER ROWS ARE BOTH IN HELENA, your number-one farm zip — one asked what her house was worth, the other tagged himself 'call me' to sell in March. Neither has ever been called.
isa.sweepCadence: every 20 to 30 minutes while the fleet is up — three sweeps already logged this morning between 6:10 and 7:15, each proving its lanes dry by enumeration rather than by silence. ✅ THE BEST WORK THIS WEEKEND WAS CATCHES, NOT SENDS. One run put two numbers on your call list and the very next run pulled them straight back off — both were on the do-not-contact register, and the lane repaired its own state rather than letting you dial a stop-request. 🔧 Another found the text-relay outage clock was being COPIED forward rather than measured, and fixed the measurement instead of the number. 📅 A third caught thirteen expired-listing owners whose own records said to re-send — it checked your sent folder instead, found all thirteen had already gone by hand, and prevented thirteen duplicate emails to thirteen sellers. 🔍 AND THIS MORNING IT CAUGHT ITS OWN INSTRUMENT LYING TWICE: a message-cap was hiding the newest message in a thread from three consecutive runs, so every run now enumerates the thread rather than trusting the list. 📥 FIFTY-FIVE DRAFTS ARE WAITING ON YOU and nothing sends on its own. Nine were rebuilt fresh this morning — and every one of them was created from the wrong sending address for seven of its recipients, so check the From line before they go.
